```{r, results = 'hide'}

den_list <- map(years, ~
  get_acs(
    geography = "tract",
    variables = vars,
    state = "CO",
    county = counties,
    year = .x,
    geometry = TRUE,
    output = "wide"
  ) %>%
    mutate(year = .x),
  error = function(e) {
      message("Year ", .x, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL})

denver <- bind_rows(den_list) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

## E is estimate, M is margin of error


```

Calculated variables
```{r}
denver <- denver %>%
  mutate(
    ## outcomes
    unemployment_rate = unemployedE / in_labor_forceE,
    mean_hours_worked = mean_hours_workedE,
    median_household_income = median_household_incomeE,
    ##control vector
    median_age = median_ageE,
    white_nonhispanic_share  = white_nonhispanicE / total_pop_raceE,
    bachelors_plus_share = (bach_mE + mast_mE + prof_mE + doct_mE +
                                 bach_fE + mast_fE + prof_fE + doct_fE) / edu_pop_25plusE,
    poverty_rate = poverty_belowE / poverty_denomE,
    residential_stability = same_house_1yrE / pop_1yr_and_overE,

    tract_area_sqmi = as.numeric(set_units(st_area(geometry), "mi^2")),
    pop_density = total_popE / tract_area_sqmi
  )
```

```{r}
treated_buffer <- st_read("treated_buffer.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(26954) %>%
  st_make_valid()

control_buffer <- st_read("control_buffer.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(26954) %>%
  st_make_valid()

tract_vintages <- denver %>%
  st_transform(26954) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(vintage = if_else(year >= 2020, "2020", "2010")) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, vintage, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(GEOID, vintage, geometry) %>%
  mutate(tract_area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))

# total overlap area between each tract and a buffer
overlap_area <- function(tracts_sf, buffer_sf, out_name) {
  inter <- st_intersection(tracts_sf, st_geometry(st_union(buffer_sf)))
  inter %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(inter$geometry))) %>%
    group_by(GEOID, vintage) %>%
    summarise(area_m2 = sum(area_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(!!out_name := area_m2)
}

treat_overlap <- overlap_area(tract_vintages, treated_buffer, "treat_int_m2")
ctrl_overlap  <- overlap_area(tract_vintages, control_buffer,  "ctrl_int_m2")

# into pct overlap and apply 40% rule 
tract_classification <- tract_vintages %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(treat_overlap, by = c("GEOID", "vintage")) %>%
  left_join(ctrl_overlap,  by = c("GEOID", "vintage")) %>%
  mutate(
    treat_int_m2 = replace_na(treat_int_m2, 0),
    ctrl_int_m2  = replace_na(ctrl_int_m2, 0),
    pct_treat = treat_int_m2/tract_area_m2 * 100,
    pct_ctrl  = ctrl_int_m2/tract_area_m2 * 100,
    group_40 = case_when(
      pct_treat >= 40 ~ "treated",
      pct_ctrl  >= 40 ~ "control",
      TRUE ~ "excluded"
    )
  )

write_csv(tract_classification, "tract_classification.csv")
```

Create REAL treatment groups
```{r}
# treatment period tags
stations_sf <- stations_sf %>%
  mutate(treat_period = case_when(
    lines == "W"~ 2013,
    lines %in% c("A", "B", "R", "E/F/R") ~ 2016,
    lines %in% c("B/G", "W/G", "G", "N") ~ 2019,
    lines == "E/F/R" ~ 2019,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
```

For each tract, find the nearest station and its distance

```{r}
nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(denver_centroids, stations_sf)
nearest_dist <- st_distance(denver_centroids, stations_sf[nearest_idx, ], by_element = TRUE)

denver_centroids <- denver_centroids %>%
  mutate(
    nearest_station = stations_sf$name[nearest_idx],
    nearest_dist_m = as.numeric(nearest_dist),
    station_period = stations_sf$treat_period[nearest_idx],
    within_1200m = nearest_dist_m <= 1200
  )
```

temporary treatment group(1200 meters)
```{r}
denver <- denver %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(denver_centroids) %>%
      select(GEOID, nearest_station, nearest_dist_m, station_period, within_1200m) %>%
      distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = case_when(
      !within_1200m ~ 0,
      year >= station_period ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    post_W   = as.integer(within_1200m & station_period == 2013 & year >= 2013),
    post_ABR = as.integer(within_1200m & station_period == 2016 & year >= 2016),
    post_GN  = as.integer(within_1200m & station_period == 2019 & year >= 2019)
  )

denver_treated <- denver %>%
  filter(treated == 1)
```

denver_doughnut <- denver %>%

########## Propensity score matching ####################
```{r}
library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)

match_cohort <- function(df) {
  matchit(
    treated_ever ~ log_income + median_age + white_nonhispanic_share +
      bachelors_plus_share + poverty_rate + residential_stability +
      unemployment_rate + log_pop_density,
    data = df,
    method = "full",
    distance = "glm",
    discard = "both"
  )
}
```

```{r}
build_baseline <- function(pre_years, cohort_label) {
  denver %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(year %in% pre_years) %>%
    group_by(GEOID, group_40) %>%
    summarise(across(
      c(unemployment_rate, median_household_income, median_age, white_nonhispanic_share,
        bachelors_plus_share, poverty_rate, residential_stability, pop_density),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      treated_ever = as.integer(GEOID %in% (denver %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                    filter(group_40 == "treated", station_period == cohort_label) %>%
                                    pull(GEOID))),
      log_income = log(median_household_income),
      log_pop_density = log(pop_density)
    ) %>%
    filter(treated_ever == 1 | group_40 %in% c("control", "excluded")) %>%
    drop_na(log_income, median_age, white_nonhispanic_share, bachelors_plus_share,
            poverty_rate, residential_stability, unemployment_rate, log_pop_density) %>%
    filter(is.finite(log_income), is.finite(log_pop_density))
}

baseline_2013 <- build_baseline(2011:2012, 2013)
baseline_2016 <- build_baseline(2014:2015, 2016)
baseline_2019 <- build_baseline(2017:2018, 2019)
```

```{r}
cohort_matches <- list(baseline_2013, baseline_2016, baseline_2019) %>%
  map(match_cohort)

matched_all <- map_dfr(cohort_matches, match.data)
```

matched_all %>% count(cohort, treated_ever, discarded = weights == 0)
matched_all %>% count(GEOID) %>% filter(n > 1)
```

```

RESULTS
```{r}
did_data <- denver_40pct %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  mutate(
    log_income = log(median_household_income),
    treat_post = as.integer(group == "Treated" & period == "Post")
  )

did_buffer <- feols(
  c(unemployment_rate, mean_hours_worked, log_income) ~ treat_post | GEOID + year,
  data = did_data, split = ~station_period, cluster = ~GEOID
)

etable(did_buffer, keep = "treat_post")
```

```{r}
psm_data <- denver %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(-any_of(c("psm_weight", "psm_sample", "station_period"))) %>%
  inner_join(
    select(matched_all, GEOID, station_period = cohort, treat = treated_ever, psm_weight = weights),
    by = "GEOID", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2011:2012 ~ "Pre",
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2018:2019 ~ "Post",
      station_period == 2016 & year %in% 2014:2015 ~ "Pre",
      station_period == 2016 & year %in% 2018:2019 ~ "Post",
      station_period == 2019 & year %in% 2017:2018 ~ "Pre",
      station_period == 2019 & year %in% 2023:2024 ~ "Post"
    ),
    log_income = log(median_household_income),
    treat_post = treat * (period == "Post")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period), psm_weight > 0)

did_psm <- feols(
  c(unemployment_rate, mean_hours_worked, log_income) ~ treat_post | GEOID + year,
  data = psm_data, weights = ~psm_weight, split = ~station_period, cluster = ~GEOID
)

etable(did_psm, keep = "treat_post")
```

COMPOUNDING EFFECTS
```{r}
comp_data <- denver_40pct %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(station_period %in% c(2013, 2016), group %in% c("Treated", "Control")) %>%
  mutate(
    log_income = log(median_household_income),
    treated    = as.integer(group == "Treated"),
    stage = case_when(
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2011:2012 ~ 0L,
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2014:2015 ~ 1L,
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2018:2019 ~ 2L,
      station_period == 2013 & year %in% 2023:2024 ~ 3L,
      station_period == 2016 & year %in% 2014:2015 ~ 0L,
      station_period == 2016 & year %in% 2018:2019 ~ 2L,
      station_period == 2016 & year %in% 2023:2024 ~ 3L)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stage)) %>%
  mutate(step1 = treated * (stage >= 1),
         step2 = treated * (stage >= 2),
         step3 = treated * (stage >= 3))

comp_13 <- feols(c(unemployment_rate, mean_hours_worked, log_income) ~ step1 + step2 + step3 | GEOID + year,
                 data = filter(comp_data, station_period == 2013), cluster = ~GEOID)
comp_16 <- feols(c(unemployment_rate, mean_hours_worked, log_income) ~ step2 + step3 | GEOID + year,
                 data = filter(comp_data, station_period == 2016), cluster = ~GEOID)

etable(comp_13, comp_16)

comp_data %>%
  select(GEOID, year, station_period, stage, step1, step2, step3,
         unemployment_rate, mean_hours_worked, log_income) %>%
  write_csv("stata_compound.csv", na = "")
```
